name: Geometric Indicator Obfuscation
description: Replaces the algebraic sum condition with a geometric one (squared magnitude of the cross product of 3D vectors mapped from the grades). Since the vectors are parallel when grades are equal, the cross product is zero, and when different, it yields a constant positive magnitude. The sum being maximized forces all adjacent nodes to have different grades, encoding bipartiteness in a vector algebra condition that static pattern matchers won't recognize as graph coloring.
